notes.title: Catjinni Survivors Demo Update
notes.content:
This update brings:

Enhanced Graphics & Performance: enjoy sharper visuals and smoother gameplay

Immersive Audio: improved sounds and full 3D audio effects

New Intro Scene & Night Music: seamless loading & fresh atmospheric tracks

Upgraded Enemies: better shaders

Gameplay Improvements: upgrades from lamps now paus after displaying the result

Refined UI & UX: new animated interface background

Balanced Gameplay: fairer challenges and improved sidequests

Dash Meter & Haptics: track dashes easily and feel every action with enhanced feedback

Localization: updated texts and translations for multiple languages

Jump back in, survive the chaos, and let us know how you like the new features, right here or on Discord!

notes.title: Demo Update: A Fresh Layer of Polish
notes.content:
Demo Update:

Redesigned Cheops to be wider and more detailed, with additional plant life and improved layout.

Added enhanced haptic effects for increased immersion and tactile feedback.

Introduced several new weapons and skills to discover and experiment with.

Improved various sound effects for a more dynamic audio experience.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug that caused the menu to remain selected after exiting.

Resolved an issue where the character backstory scroll window could appear empty.

Fixed a bug where unlocked achievements were incorrectly highlighted again when re-entering the menu.



I’d love to hear what you think, your feedback helps shape the next steps!

notes.title: Demo Update – Progression Fixes, New Boss, Balance Improvements & More
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I’ve just updated the demo with several important changes, improvements, and fixes based on internal testing and player feedback. Here’s what’s new:

Major Changes

Progression Fix: Level-ups now trigger correctly and consistently.

New First Boss: The first boss has been changed from Arakne to the Maneater Boss.

New Enemy Added: Introduced a new standard enemy in Cheops – the Wild Boar. It’s faster than mummies but still goes down in one or two hits.

Cheops Level Layout Updated: The level has been made wider to improve movement and combat flow.
Balance & Gameplay
Luck Rework: Luck is no longer scaled in flat 1%–10% steps. It now influences XP and heart drop rates in a more balanced way.

New Upgrades Added:

One upgrade reduces the duration of night.

One upgrade reduces the duration of day.

Lighting Adjustment: The night phase is now brighter for better visibility.
Bug Fixes & Optimization
Fixed several issues with enemy interactions during dashing, especially cases where enemies would behave unpredictably.

Improved code performance across the board for better overall gameplay smoothness.
[hr][/hr]
This update also includes various smaller fixes and tweaks not listed here. I'll continuing to fine-tune the demo, and your feedback is incredibly valuable!

Try the updated demo and let me know what you think!

Thank you for playing and supporting the project.
